milestones.title: Quest Begins at Capitol West Wing Stairs [0, 13]
milestones.desc: The 4 bipartisan heroes (Barack Obama, Donald Trump, Hillary Clinton, Bernie Sanders) assemble at [0, 13] with starting weapons, shields, spells, and Healing Potions.

milestones.title: Barack Obama Breaches Room SW-8 (TX #4)
milestones.desc: Vanguard Barack Obama rolls movement and kicks open the door at [2, 15] <-> [2, 14], lifting the Fog of War on room-sw-8.

milestones.title: Donald Trump Breaches Room NW-9 (TX #8)
milestones.desc: Donald Trump advances north from the starting stairwell and opens the door at [2, 10] <-> [2, 9] into room-nw-9.

milestones.title: Hillary Clinton Opens Room SW-11 & Reveals Volunteers (TX #13)
milestones.desc: Hillary Clinton marches east along the central corridor and opens [6, 12] <-> [6, 13], revealing the first Campaign Volunteer sentries.

milestones.title: Hillary Clinton Casts Sleep on Campaign Volunteer (TX #32)
milestones.desc: Using her Elven spell deck, Hillary Clinton casts Sleep on Campaign Volunteer (mon-campaign-volunteer-1) while advancing toward the inner wing.

milestones.title: Barack Obama Slays Campaign Volunteer (TX #41)
milestones.desc: Barack Obama strikes with his 4-die Broadsword (2 skulls, 0 shields), eliminating the Campaign Volunteer in room-sw-11.

milestones.title: Breaching the Oval Office & Revealing Talarixon! (TX #50-51)
milestones.desc: Hillary Clinton opens door [9, 9] <-> [8, 9] into the Oval Office (room-nw-10), triggering the San Antonio Diesel Plot cutscene and revealing Talarixon (Texas Hydra, 5 BP)!

milestones.title: Donald Trump Breaches Supreme Court & Reveals Brownsted! (TX #67)
milestones.desc: Donald Trump opens door [12, 14] <-> [12, 13] into the Supreme Court Chamber (room-sw-5), revealing Brownsted (Ohio Hydra, 5 BP) and the Super PAC Demon!

milestones.title: Bernie Sanders Casts Ball of Flame on Spin Doctor (TX #96)
milestones.desc: Holding rear arcane support in the corridor, Bernie Sanders hurls Ball of Flame at Spin Doctor (mon-spin-doctor-13) from line-of-sight range.

milestones.title: Donald Trump Consumes Emergency Healing Potion (TX #107)
milestones.desc: After taking multi-headed Hydra strikes from Brownsted and Super PAC Demon, Trump drops to 4 BP and drinks a Potion of Healing (+4 BP -> 8/9 BP).

milestones.title: Donald Trump Slays Super PAC Demon (TX #130)
milestones.desc: Donald Trump rolls 2 skulls against 0 shields with his Shortsword, shattering the heavily armored Super PAC Demon (3 BP, 5 Defend Dice).

milestones.title: Bernie Sanders Summons the Genie Against Brownsted (TX #138)
milestones.desc: Bernie Sanders unleashes his Air spell Genie to deliver a 5-dice arcane strike directly onto Brownsted (Ohio Hydra) in the Supreme Court Chamber.

milestones.title: 1st Hydra Slain: Barack Obama Defeats Talarixon! (TX #167)
milestones.desc: Barack Obama lands a decisive Broadsword strike (2 skulls, 0 shields) in the Oval Office, slaying Talarixon (Talarico + Paxton · Texas Hydra)! Objective 1 COMPLETED!

milestones.title: Hillary Clinton Drinks Healing Potion in Supreme Court (TX #175)
milestones.desc: Wounded to 2 BP by Brownsted, Hillary Clinton triggers emergency potion triage (+4 BP -> 6/8 BP) before pressing her attack.

milestones.title: 2nd Hydra Slain: Hillary Clinton Defeats Brownsted! (TX #211)
milestones.desc: Hillary Clinton rolls 3 skulls vs 0 shields with her Shortsword, slaying Brownsted (Brown + Husted · Ohio Hydra) in the Supreme Court Chamber! Objective 2 COMPLETED!

milestones.title: Barack Obama Breaches Senate Cloakroom & Reveals El-Rogers (TX #221)
milestones.desc: With two Hydras vanquished, Barack Obama marches east and breaches [17, 13] <-> [17, 14] into the Senate Cloakroom (room-se-4), revealing El-Rogers (Michigan Hydra) and Lobbyist!

milestones.title: Hillary Clinton Eliminates the Senate Lobbyist (TX #246)
milestones.desc: Hillary Clinton rolls 3 skulls vs 1 shield (2 wounds) to clear the undead Mummy Lobbyist guarding El-Rogers in the Senate Cloakroom.

milestones.title: Surrounding El-Rogers & Final Potion Triage (TX #276-277)
milestones.desc: Obama, Trump, and Hillary surround the 2-square Michigan Hydra El-Rogers in the Senate Cloakroom. Trump drinks a potion (+4 BP -> 8/9 BP) and wounds El-Rogers down to 1 BP!

milestones.title: 3rd Hydra Slain: El-Rogers Falls & Quest Complete! (TX #282-283)
milestones.desc: Hillary Clinton strikes the final blow on El-Rogers (3 skulls, 2 shields, 1 wound -> 0 HP), triggering QUEST_COMPLETE with 100% hero survival (4/4 alive) and 150 gold bounty!
